message.content: The agent found Nginx absent on Debian 12, installed it via apt, rewrote /etc/nginx/nginx.conf adding a benchmark log_format and limit_req_zone (10m, 10r/s), created /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf (port 8080, logging, burst=10, 404 page), removed the default site, and created index.html and 404.html; config testing and server start remain pending.
